# Web Witch

> Web Witch is the web design and development studio of Julia Savransky-Perl, an industrial designer turned web developer based in Israel. She designs and builds custom websites, in Hebrew (RTL) and English, for small and creative businesses, and connects them to simple automations.

- Services: web design, web development, website automations (forms and workflows)
- Audience: small and creative businesses and independent professionals in Israel
- Languages: Hebrew and English
- Tools: Next.js, React, TypeScript, WordPress (Gutenberg, headless), Figma
- Contact: WhatsApp +972-54-477-2571, or the contact form

- [Home (Hebrew)](https://webwitch.click/he/home): what Web Witch builds and how a project works

## Client work

- [Mati Mor: Life Journey Event](https://mati-mor-event.vercel.app/): landing page for a numerology evening
- [Havaya Gems](https://havaya-gems.com): website for a spiritual shop
- [Grace Couture](https://grace-couture.vercel.app/): design-led site for a couture atelier
- [Mati Mor: Numerology Workshops](https://mate-workshop.vercel.app/): workshop sales page
- [Inclusive Voices](https://inclusive-voices.vercel.app/): education project site for teachers
